name: The Truth Beneath the Mask
objective: In the central chamber you meet Director Krampus, leader of the local operation. Instead of fighting, he explains Team Krampus.
intro: The Director's voice is quiet and certain. He does not raise it. He does not need to.
dialogue: Director Krampus: "For centuries, humans have tried to make this world comfortable."
Director Krampus: "They built walls. They built cities. They built rules."
Director Krampus: "And every generation, the Pokémon grew weaker."
Director Krampus: "Powerful Pokémon are disappearing because humans have made the world too safe. We will restore the old balance."
Director Krampus: "Then you have chosen the easy path."
lore_discovery: Team Krampus wants to restore the old balance between humans and Pokémon — but is willing to forcibly evolve, manipulate, and experiment on Pokémon to accomplish it.
